title: [FMLA 12] ParallelLRC — Impedance LRC Parallel
summary: Parallel RLC impedance at frequency f. Type f in Hz; the ROM uses 2πf, not a separate ω prompt.

body.text: Calculator scroll name: ParallelLRC. Parallel RLC impedance at frequency f. Type f in Hz; do not type ω into the f prompt.
In parallel the three parts share the same voltage. At resonance the L and C branches cancel, so very little current flows and Z looks large.

body.caption: Same R, L, C as the series page, but in parallel. Now Z is largest at f₀ — the opposite dip/peak from series.

body.text: Primary inputs: f, R, L, C (frequency in Hz, not ω).

body.title: How to run
items: Press FMLA, then 1, then 2 (or scroll to the name and EXE)

body.label: Units
body.text: SI: f in Hz, L in H, C in F, R and Z in Ω (all > 0). The formula uses 2πf; there is no ω input.
